signature.name: Alhambra
signature.detail: The Nasrid palace complex on a hill above the city is Granada's defining sight, with intricate Islamic stucco, tiled courtyards and the Nasrid Palaces. Timed-entry tickets sell out, so book well ahead, especially for evening visits. Wear comfortable shoes, because the site is large and sloped.

signature.name: Generalife
signature.detail: The summer palace and gardens sit next to the Alhambra and are known for their water channels, terraces and cypress-lined paths. It is best seen in late afternoon, when the light is soft. Entry is usually bundled with Alhambra tickets, so check your booking.

signature.name: Albayzín
signature.detail: This hillside quarter of whitewashed lanes and cave-style houses has some of the best views of the Alhambra, especially from its miradors. Walk it in the late afternoon or at sunset. Wear sturdy shoes, as the streets are steep and cobbled.

signature.name: Sacromonte
signature.detail: Sacromonte is known for its hillside caves, historic Romani community and flamenco. Many cave venues host evening shows. Go by taxi or a guided tour after dark, since the lanes are steep and poorly lit.

signature.name: Granada Cathedral
signature.detail: The Renaissance cathedral in the city centre holds a richly decorated interior and a notable chapel. It is close to the Royal Chapel, so the two make an easy pairing. Visit in the morning, when the crowds are thinner.

signature.name: Royal Chapel of Granada
signature.detail: The Gothic-Renaissance chapel holds the tombs of Ferdinand and Isabella and the Catholic Monarchs. It is a short walk from the cathedral in the historic centre. Buy tickets at the entrance and allow about an hour.

signature.name: Corral del Carbón
signature.detail: This 14th-century former granary with a Moorish horseshoe arch is one of the few remaining Islamic-era buildings in the city centre. It is a quick stop on a walk through the old bazaar area. It is free to enter and easy to reach on foot.

food: Tapas with a drink $8-15; sit-down meal $15-30
stay: Good 3-4* hotel $100-160 a night; budget guesthouse $50-80
transport: City bus $1.50-2 a ride; taxis $5-12 across the centre; Alhambra shuttle bus about $2
